hook.say: The ten largest countries on Earth, ranked. Number one is almost twice the size of number two!

outro.say: Which ones have you visited? Comment below!

items.name: Algeria
items.say: Number ten: Algeria, the largest country in Africa. Two-point-four million square kilometers.
items.cap: Number ten: Algeria, the largest country in Africa. 2.4 million square kilometers.

items.name: Kazakhstan
items.say: Nine: Kazakhstan, the largest landlocked country. Two-point-seven million.
items.cap: Nine: Kazakhstan, the largest landlocked country. 2.7 million.

items.name: Argentina
items.say: Eight: Argentina, the largest Spanish-speaking country. Two-point-eight million.
items.cap: Eight: Argentina, the largest Spanish-speaking country. 2.8 million.

items.name: India
items.say: Seven: India, home to the most people on Earth. Three-point-three million.
items.cap: Seven: India, home to the most people on Earth. 3.3 million.

items.name: Australia
items.say: Six: Australia, a country and a continent. Seven-point-seven million.
items.cap: Six: Australia, a country and a continent. 7.7 million.

items.name: Brazil
items.say: Five: Brazil, nearly half of South America. Eight-point-five million.
items.cap: Five: Brazil, nearly half of South America. 8.5 million.

items.name: United States
items.say: Four: United States, though some lists rank it third. Nine-point-five million.
items.cap: Four: United States, though some lists rank it third. 9.5 million.

items.name: China
items.say: Three: China, bordering fourteen countries. Nine-point-six million.
items.cap: Three: China, bordering fourteen countries. 9.6 million.

items.name: Canada
items.say: Two: Canada, with the longest coastline on Earth. Nearly 10 million.
items.cap: Two: Canada, with the longest coastline on Earth. Nearly 10 million.

items.name: Russia
items.say: And number one: Russia! Seventeen-point-one million square kilometers, spanning eleven time zones.
items.cap: And number one: Russia! 17.1 million square kilometers, spanning eleven time zones.
